title: Social attention to next-day realized variance
claim: Causal social-attention features improve next-day realized-variance forecasts over the strongest market-only model across assets.
mechanism: Elevated attention identifies information episodes whose volatility persists through the next UTC day.
target: Next UTC-day realized variance from one-minute Binance returns

evidence.summary: Blind July improved in 9/10 assets but did not survive multiplicity adjustment: raw p=0.0811, Holm-adjusted p=0.2434.

nextAction: Keep the opened target rejected; only a new version with fresh outcomes may revisit daily variance.
